## Page 15

Outlook and Key Themes
Influencing Our Operating Environment
15Geopolitics conflict and Global Trade volatility
The reciprocal tariff that announced by US to all countries that export goods to US, has 
caused investors exposure to the complexity of new US trade policy that effected and volatile to landscape of trade around the world.
Regional Competition
ASEAN was benefited from manufacturing base relocation out of China. Thailand’s 
competitiveness are experience and skilled labor, strong supply chains in manufacturing sector and infrastructure supports. 
Competitive Supply in logistics market
New supply of warehouse injected to the market. However, FTREIT has assets in strategic location that is strong capability to compete other supply in the market.
Demand for High -Specification Facilities
While demand for industrial space continues in strategic locations like EEC, there is a 
growing need for "smart parks" and facilities that adhere to ESG standards (e.g., green building certification). 
•Maintain high occupancy rate through active portfolio management to handle with the changes in the economic environment, industry trends, and tenant demands
•Acquisition focus on best -in-class, high-quality assets 
strategically located in key industrial and logistics areas of Thailand.
•Foster strong tenant relationships through continuous engagement and operational support, and strong sustainability credentials aligned with their ESG requirements.
•Continue to explore development opportunities within development limit
•Maintain optimal capital structure with diverse funding sources.
FTREIT’s Approach
Cost Pressure
Operators and developers will contend with rising business costs, notably higher 
land prices, construction material costs, and labor expenses.
